programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: September 8, 1989. High above the North Sea, an aging propeller plane tumbles from the sky. Investigators consider a string of possibilities; it takes two years to find the cause. It's something that's never been seen in previous investigations. It would lead to arrests half a world away and call into question the safety of one of the world's most important planes, Air Force One.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: August 22nd, 1985. With 137 people on board, the crew of British Air tours Flight 28 is preparing to leave Manchester Airport for the Greek island of Corfu. Just as the aircraft is accelerating, a loud 'thud' emanates from outside the plane. Investigators from the AAIB need to figure out how an emergency on an aeroplane that never even left the ground turned into one of the worst disasters in British aviation history.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: August 16th, 1987, Flight 255 is on the tarmac and bound for Phoenix, Arizona. The pilots have trouble locating the runway, but once they do, the airplane roars down the runway and barely manages to leave the ground before hitting a pole and slamming into a building, quickly disintegrating. This is the second deadliest airplane disaster in US history, but can investigators determine what went wrong?

programme.title: Mighty Planes S1 E6
programme.desc: The Martin Mars water bomber is the world's biggest seaplane. Originally one of five flying cargo planes it was built in 1945 for the US Navy. In 1958, it was converted into a water bomber and has since flown over 8000 firefighting missions. The Mars water bomber is part of the most effective firefighting regime that forest services can call upon when ground crews are powerless to extinguish the flames. Countless wildfires threaten to destroy vast expanses of wilderness, cattle ranches and remote mountain villages. Answering the call for help the Mars on for a 20 day mission to make a relentless aerial assault on the flames but mechanical breakdowns, severe weather and exhaustion threaten to end the mission at every turn.

programme.title: Mighty Ships S4 E1

programme.title: S06 E06 - Haunted Reform School

She has a daughter with Ji Ho, and she would do anything for her. However, she gets tragically betrayed by Ji Ho, the love of her life, over power and money. How will those two mothers end their fierce revenge?

programme.title: People and Power
programme.sub-title: In Their Own Hands - Ghana's Drug Vigilantes
programme.desc: Citizen vigilantes patrol Ghana's streets, fighting an opioid crisis. We meet those taking the law into their own hands.
programme.series-desc:
People & Power is a current affairs programme on Al Jazeera English which broadcasts once a week, on Wednesdays, and repeated throughout the week.
Each half-hour programme features one investigative documentaries on an issue related to power from around the world. The programme occasionally has one hour specials.
